meta.title: Breadboard (half, 400-pt) — starter template
meta.intro: Terminal strips are vertical 5-hole columns (a–e = rows 4–8, f–j = rows 10–14) split by the center ravine (row 9). Power rails run along rows 1–2 (top) and 16–17 (bottom). Replace the placeholder module with your own parts.
buildOrder: Seat parts across the ravine, then wire power (+ rail) and ground (− rail) first.
